camel_example: aliyun sandbox GET /pop/2026-08-20/teams --region cn-hangzhou --teamName '开发团队' --pageNumber 1 --pageSize 20 --resourceGroupID 'rg-acfmwxqyrgwabcd' --plan pro --header "Content-Type=application/json" --version 2026-08-20 --force

E2BTeam.description_en: The team information. Describes a sandbox team and its plan, status, and resource ownership
E2BTeam.description_zh: 团队信息。描述一个沙箱团队及其套餐、状态和资源归属

allowUpdateTeamName.description_en: Specifies whether the team name can be modified. The default team does not allow modification
allowUpdateTeamName.description_zh: 是否允许修改团队名称。默认团队不允许修改

createdTime.description_en: The creation time of the team in UTC, in RFC 3339 format
createdTime.description_zh: 团队的创建时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 RFC 3339

plan.description_en:
The team plan specification. Valid values:
eco: economy.
std: standard.
pro: professional.
ent: enterprise
plan.description_zh: 团队套餐规格。取值：eco（经济型）、std（标准型）、pro（专业型）、ent（企业型）

readOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the current caller has read-only access to the team. If the value is true, the team configuration cannot be modified
readOnly.description_zh: 当前调用者对该团队是否只读。为 true 时不能修改团队配置

resourceGroupID.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group to which the team belongs
resourceGroupID.description_zh: 团队所属的阿里云资源组 ID

status.description_en:
The team status. Valid values:
active: Normal.
deleting: Being deleted.
delete_failed: Failed to delete
status.description_zh: 团队状态。取值：active（正常）、deleting（删除中）、delete_failed（删除失败）

teamID.description_en: The ID of the team to which the resource belongs, in UUID format
teamID.description_zh: 资源所属团队的 ID，为 UUID 格式

userID.description_en: The user ID of the team creator, in UUID format
userID.description_zh: 团队创建者的用户 ID，为 UUID 格式

description_en: Queries the list of teams by using paging
name: ListTeams

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值为 1，取值范围为 1～10000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of teams to return on each page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的团队数量。默认值为 10，取值范围为 1～100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Filters teams by plan specifications. Valid values: eco (Economy), std (Standard), pro (Professional), and ent (Enterprise)
parameters.help_zh: 按团队套餐规格筛选。取值：eco（经济型）、std（标准型）、pro（专业型）、ent（企业型）
parameters.name: plan

code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates success

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 响应消息。成功时为 success

pageNumber.description_en: The page number of the current query

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for the current query
pageSize.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页条数

items.description_en: The information about a single team

total.description_en: The total number of teams that meet the query conditions
total.description_zh: 符合查询条件的团队总数
